spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: Haz para ti un serafín, y ponlo sobre un asta, y será todo el mordido, y lo verá, y vivirá.

findings.issue: שָׂרָף is a common noun, masculine singular absolute. «serafín» names an angelic being and closes that noun on a theological category the token does not license.

«será todo el mordido» can be read as a copula with «todo el mordido» as complement (one whole referent). וְהָיָה plus כָּל plus the singular passive participle leaves the bitten one as the subject of the following verbs.

notes: Imperatives, masculine object suffixes, and the see/live chain match the token morphology.
